system.description:
You raise your weapon to react to incoming damage. When you would take damage, you swipe your weapon with incredible power against a creature in range. Make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal your [Weapons damage] + 2d12 and gain 1d12 temporary hit points which are applied before the result of the triggering attack is applied.

Chain 1: This attack ignores temporary hit points, dealing damage directly to the targets hit points.

Chain 2: This attack gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the temporary hit points gained by 1d12.
